summary: Steep through-road kerb with no parked cars, and houses 5-20 m away.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked along kerb

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb: semi-detached homes 5-9 m away, others 18-20 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide multi-lane through road between roundabouts; no parking lane or pull-off, and no cars parked on this side.
drivers.traffic: Busy collector road linking roundabouts, with a junction at the south end.
drivers.convention: No signs and no parked cars; nobody parks here.

flags: Low ground (about 5.5 m) 37 m from Toowong Creek at the north end
